description: Type setPolicyFile's and previewRuleMatches's 400 as PolicyFileRejected instead of the spec's message-only BadRequest, so callers keep the per-source findings. A rejected policy file's 400 body is {message, data: [{user, errors, warnings}] | null}: tailscale/tailscale client/tailscale/acl.go (3ec5be3f5) decodes every non-200 from POST /tailnet/{tailnet}/acl as ACLTestError{message, data []ACLTestFailureSummary} with user, errors and warnings omitempty and data not; tailscale-client-go-v2 client.go (9b68d9333) decodes every API error as APIError{message, data []APIErrorData{user, errors}}; the spec's /acl/validate 200 documents the same {message, data: [{user, errors | warnings}]} shape. Every 400 on these operations takes the class, since a body matcher cannot test for the data array; data is optional. The class is hand-written in src/errors.ts so its body is typed; the generator skips this shape (HAND_WRITTEN_ERRORS in scripts/generate.ts).
